name: Cilium
description: eBPF-based networking, security and observability for Kubernetes.
summary: Generative AI may help explain code, autocomplete, refactor, brainstorm and draft tests, as long as contributors review everything, take full responsibility, respect licensing and report non-trivial AI use. Messages substantially written by AI are not acceptable in community spaces, though translation help is understood.

evidence.quote: Whether or not Generative AI tools were involved, you are fully accountable for the correctness, security, and clarity of your contributions.
Human review is required for all code, including code generated or assisted by Generative AI tools.
Report the use of Generative AI tools for non-trivial preparation of submissions
Ensure the output adheres to project guidelines and licensing requirements; and
Communicate in any Cilium community space with content that is substantially written using Generative AI tools.
For example, it is not acceptable to send such text on Slack or GitHub, whether initiating or responding to discussion with other community members.
